transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi. Well, I came in because people keep telling me they can’t follow what I’m trying to explain. It's been happening a lot with my work lately. 

My artist statements, my notes to clients, or even just what I say out loud in meetings... I guess they just start jumping all over the place. I'll go from talking about the textures of a piece, straight into budgets, and then into... like, secret meanings. It makes sense in my head, but I'm having a really hard time getting my point across to anyone else.
Lately, have you felt like you need much less sleep than usual while still having plenty of energy?

Yeah, actually, I have. If I'm working late, I can sleep for just two or three hours, and then... I just wake up feeling bright and ready to keep going. I'm not tired the way I normally would be on that amount of rest.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don't seem to hear or see?

Yeah, I have. Um... when I’m alone in the studio, I sometimes hear a woman quietly commenting from behind the shelves. Or I'll smell hot metal right near an unfinished piece. It feels completely real when it happens, but... when I actually stop to check, there’s nobody there, and nothing is burning. So, yeah, I guess I have been experiencing that.
Have you ever had a period in the past lasting a couple of weeks or more where you felt intensely depressed, down, or hopeless?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had days where I felt a little stressed or down, but nothing that lasted for weeks or made me feel completely hopeless like that.
Has there ever been another time in your life when you felt this unusually energized or had your thoughts moving this fast?

No, not really. This is... this is the first time I've felt quite like this. Usually, my energy levels are pretty steady, so this feeling of just being able to go and go without needing to stop is new for me.
